title: Not Gold color
text:
Not Gold color. THESE ARE NOT GOLD. They are bronze almost brown. This picture makes them look bigger than they actually are. They are of good quality.
NOTE: With this particular seller, you cannot return them without paying return postage.
Also, they were shipped in a baggy and were hand counted. They did not come in a container.
